dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The dorsal surface features several prominent, irregularly shaped 'O' and 'C' structures with light-grey, thin perimeters. These edges are characterized by jagged, convoluted geometry with a sharp pixel-intensity transition from the dark base coat to the light-intensity boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of small, asymmetrical white blobs concentrated on the neck and lower facial region, appearing as a dense, non-gradient speckled cluster.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Connecting the centroids of the three largest light-bordered rings on the mid-dorsal region forms an obtuse, elongated triangle whose longest side aligns with the animal's longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of deep, parallel vertical dark grooves or cutaneous folds are visible on the lower flank. A localized, high-intensity orange-red spot is visible on the distal edge of the rear flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: The complex, map-like reticulated pattern transition from the dorsal flank to the fine-grained speckling on the cranial region is a unique structural feature.
